issue.title: nogo binary passing through .bazelrc fails "bazel info"
issue.body:
<!-- Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks! -->

### What version of rules_go are you using?

8e6cfa5ef437aca79a987ad87e093c2065d71394

### What version of Bazel are you using?

3.0.0

### Does this issue reproduce with the latest releases of all the above?

I don't know

### What operating system and processor architecture are you using?

Darwin amd64


### What did you do?

```
$ echo "build --@io_bazel_rules_go//go/config:nogo=@io_bazel_rules_go//:tools_nogo" >> .bazelrc 
$ bazel info
```

### What did you expect to see?

Some bazel information

### What did you see instead?

```
ERROR: unknown key: '--@io_bazel_rules_go//go/config:nogo=@io_bazel_rules_go//:tools_nogo'
```

body: @juliexxia is investigating. We believe there's a fast fix for this.
It seems like bazel info doesn't need to know about build settings at all, so working on a change to ignore them for the info command.

issue.title: Trying to generate clang.bazelrc using bazel/setup_clang.sh results in an error

labels.name: stale
labels.description: stalebot believes this issue/PR has not been touched recently

issue.body:
The error is `ERROR: at most one key may be specified` and it's due to bazel unable to handle starlark flags in bazerc (see https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/11301). 

https://github.com/envoyproxy/envoy/pull/12376 is the commit that introduced the breaking change. The issue has been fixed in bazel 3.3.0.

issue.title: Respect Starlark options with values in `removeStarlarkOptions()`

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: Correct, reproducible, and fast builds for everyone.

issue.body:
Related: https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/11301
(Partially fixed in https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/2ec58f60ae1732f4c1d09330c4583050ac8d1f46)

Motivation:

`StarlarkOptionsParser.removeStarlarkOptions()` doesn't take the case
into account where the specified Starlark option has a value, e.g.
`--//my_rules/custom_flags:foo=bar`.

Modifications:

- Do not pass a Starlark flag value when validating the flag name.

Result:

`bazel info` does not fail anymore when `.bazelrc` contains a statement
like the following:

    build --//my_rules/custom_flags:foo=bar
